acquisition: Inputs were retrieved from public owner-run GitHub mirrors because the unauthenticated DrivenData data tab requires login in this environment. Hashes establish byte identity with these pinned public mirrors, not authenticated organizer delivery.

labels.tif.role: known catalogue-label raster; only used for exact-label suppression and exact-pixel masking of validation proxy truth

sample_submission.tif.role: grid/footprint and nodata template only; sample values are not treated as truth

current_643cbe.role: current owner-derived SGMC proxy; local validation instrument only, not organizer truth

historical_h2b_26d142.role: archived H2-B SGMC proxy instrument; retained separately for reproducing its 2026-10-05 score

validation_proxies.provenance_boundary: Both proxy rasters are owner-derived mirrors of SGMC material. The byte mismatch is resolved to two separately pinned source files; they are close but not identical rasterizations and are never substituted for organizer ground truth. See docs/reports/proxy-pin-reconciliation-20261006.md.

sample_grid.outside_semantics: NaN only outside the finite sample footprint

irregularities: The mirrored sample template has positive known-label pixels although some competition text describes an all-zero example; it is used for grid/footprint only.
The current 643cbe proxy has no nodata tag; the historical 26d142 file has nodata=255 but contains no 255-valued pixels. Both have the exact sample shape, transform, and CRS.
1,450 raster cells differ between the two proxy files; Pearson r=0.991230 and positive-support Jaccard=0.982655. Their holdout scores must not be quoted as the same instrument.
